Защитное действие ограничителя перенапря: The protective action of a surge arrester is based on the following: when an overvoltage dangerous to the insulation occurs, owing to the high non-linearity of the resistors a considerable impulse current flows through the arrester, as a result of which the overvoltage is reduced to a level safe for the insulation of the protected equipment. In normal operation the current through the arrester is capacitive and amounts to tenths of a milliampere. But when overvoltages occur, the {0} resistors become conductive and limit any further rise of the overvoltage to a level safe for the insulation of the protected electrical installation. When the overvoltage subsides, the arrester returns to the non-conducting state.
